name: Exp_Trend_Intensity_Index
summary: This EA implements the Trend Intensity Index (TII) strategy, a trend-following indicator that measures the strength and direction of a trend by comparing the deviation of price from its moving average. It generates buy signals when the TII rises above a threshold indicating strong uptrend momentum, and sell signals when it falls below a threshold indicating strong downtrend momentum.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了趋势强度指数(TII)策略，通过衡量价格偏离其移动平均线的程度来判断趋势的强度和方向。当TII上升超过阈值时发出买入信号，表示上升趋势动能强劲；当TII下跌低于阈值时发出卖出信号，表示下降趋势动能强劲。
strategy_analysis: 趋势强度指数(TII)策略的核心概念是通过计算价格相对于移动平均线的偏离来量化趋势强度。入场条件为：当TII值从下方突破买入阈值（通常为80）时开多单，表示上升趋势强劲；当TII值从上方跌破卖出阈值（通常为20）时开空单，表示下降趋势强劲。出场条件通常包括反向信号触发平仓、止损和止盈设置。仓位管理方面，EA允许通过参数调整手数大小，可能支持固定手数或基于资金的动态手数计算。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损参数来控制单笔交易风险，但具体的风险控制机制取决于参数配置。整体策略属于典型的趋势跟踪系统，适合在明确趋势行情中运行，但在震荡行情中可能产生较多虚假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The Trend Intensity Index (TII) strategy core concept quantifies trend strength by calculating how much price deviates from its moving average. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when TII crosses above the buy threshold (typically 80), indicating strong uptrend momentum; a sell signal is generated when TII crosses below the sell threshold (typically 20), indicating strong downtrend momentum. Exit conditions typically include closing positions on reverse signal triggers, as well as stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing is managed through configurable lot size parameters, potentially supporting both fixed lot and equity-based dynamic sizing. Money management incorporates stop-loss parameters to control per-trade risk exposure, though the specific risk control mechanism depends on parameter configuration. The overall strategy is a classic trend-following system that performs well in clear trending markets but may generate numerous false signals during choppy or ranging conditions.

parameters.name: MAPeriod
parameters.description: 移动平均线周期，用于计算TII的基础均线
parameters.description_en: MA period for TII base moving average calculation

parameters.name: TII_Power
parameters.description: TII幂次，控制偏离度的放大程度
parameters.description_en: TII power exponent, controls deviation amplification

parameters.name: BuyLevel
parameters.description: 买入阈值，TII突破此值时开多单
parameters.description_en: Buy threshold, open long when TII exceeds this

parameters.name: SellLevel
parameters.description: 卖出阈值，TII跌破此值时开空单
parameters.description_en: Sell threshold, open short when TII falls below this

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take profit

parameters.name: Timeframe
parameters.description: 计算TII所用的时间周期，0为当前周期
parameters.description_en: TII calculation timeframe, 0 for current period

pros: 趋势强度量化明确，通过0-100的指标值直观反映趋势强弱
阈值可调，交易者可根据市场波动性和交易风格灵活调整买卖阈值
策略逻辑清晰简洁，基于单一指标减少了过度拟合的风险
适合趋势明显的市场环境，能较好地捕捉中长期趋势行情
pros_en: Clear quantification of trend strength with a 0-100 scale that intuitively reflects trend intensity
Adjustable thresholds allow traders to fine-tune entry levels based on market volatility and trading style
Clean and simple strategy logic based on a single indicator reduces the risk of overfitting
Performs well in clearly trending markets, effectively capturing medium to long-term trend moves
cons: 在震荡行情中容易产生虚假信号，导致频繁开平仓亏损
默认止损止盈为0，如果不手动设置则完全没有风险控制
缺乏多时间框架确认机制，单一周期信号可靠性有限
未考虑交易成本（点差、佣金），在低盈亏比信号上可能净亏损
仓位管理较为简单，缺乏基于波动率或账户风险的动态调整
cons_en: Prone to false signals in ranging or choppy markets, leading to frequent losing trades from whipsaws
Default stop-loss and take-profit are zero, meaning no risk control unless manually configured
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, limiting signal reliability from a single timeframe perspective
Does not account for trading costs (spread, commission), potentially resulting in net losses on low reward-to-risk signals
Position sizing is simplistic, lacking volatility-based or account-risk-based dynamic adjustment
improvements: 增加多时间框架确认机制，例如在H4判断趋势方向后用H1入场
引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动性自动调整风控参数
添加趋势过滤器（如ADX），在趋势强度不足时禁止交易以减少震荡市假信号
加入资金管理模块，支持基于账户余额百分比的动态仓位计算
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation, e.g., determine trend direction on H4 before entering on H1
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit that adjusts to market volatility automatically
Add a trend filter (such as ADX) to disable trading when trend strength is insufficient, reducing false signals in ranging markets
Integrate a money management module supporting dynamic position sizing based on account equity percentage

risk_points: 默认止损止盈为0，若用户未手动配置则交易完全没有风险保护
趋势指标在震荡市中频繁产生假信号可能导致连续亏损
缺乏持仓数量检查，可能在同一方向重复开仓放大风险
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit are zero, leaving trades completely unprotected if users do not manually configure them
Trend indicator generates frequent false signals in ranging markets, potentially causing consecutive losses
Lacks position count checks, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction and amplifying risk
